notes.title: Full Release & Biggest Update on Oct 13!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/3576b3ce67065fbc1144c13c731b8ab114672c6c.jpg

Hi everyone!

SuchArt has been in Early Access for a year and a few months, and this period has been indeed fruitful: the game has 97% positive reviews, over 200k wishlists, and almost 800k players taking Creative Space into account – a great amount of work has been put into SuchArt, and we see that you guys appreciate it.

As much as we’d like to keep the intrigue, the title already gave it away – yes, the big moment has arrived, and SuchArt finally leaves Early Access on October 13, 10 AM PT. Moreover, it also gets its biggest update to yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

The full release update will introduce a whole bunch of new content: reworked studio and gallery, a new Hangar area with its own game mechanics, new tools, items, commissions, and much, much more. We’ll tell you everything about the new stuff upon the release – it’s super exciting, take our word for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37471138/a35180f9ab63bf751975da7f444ccc21fe2b9ae2.jpg

To celebrate an event of such magnitude, everyone will be able to grab the game with a 20% launch discount. Besides, SuchArt can be purchased as a part of our bundle with House flipper with an additional 15% off.

We hope you’re as excited about the upcoming full release as we are! If you’ve been following and (hopefully) enjoying SuchArt for a while now, you can help us spread the word about the game and share it with your friends or, say, your favourite influencer – this would be the greatest help possible!


Set a reminder for October 13, make sure you’ve got enough space on your computer, and get ready to conquer new artistic horizons – your most fascinating creative journey is yet ahead!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

notes.notes:
Hey everyone :)

Here is a small update with a few changes and fixes:

- Added German language
- Create/load game: added buttons to open a specific save folder in the Windows explorer

notes.title: Update 1.2.15.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The full game is around the corner, yet we continue to polish Creative Space for you as well, because it's this version you're playing now, and, I mean, why not. 

So, what's new:


Additions and changes

 Added Japanese
 Added 10 more save slots
 Added VSync option to the LimitFPS game option
 Hightech easel now has a button to reset rotations
 Minor rendering improvements for some brushes’ head
 Adjusted cursor speed in menus
 Adjusted movement and rotation forces of the objects being grabbed and moved by the player


Fixes

 Much less buggy bobblehead physics
 Fixed stencils could prevent paint from drying, even after being detached
 Fixed some tools FXs (such as the smoke after using the blowtorch) would suddenly disappear if the player switched for another tool
 Snapping objects (such as a canvas on an easel) should now be better at finding the closest angle
 Player now always properly recovered if glitched out of the studio
 Fixed the head of the standard brush could sometimes become invisible
 Fixed couldn’t use a gamepad in the main menu (after game launch) without having at least one mouse click first
 Fixed stencils clipping when overlapping
 Fixed could send 2 paintings for the same commission by using both terminals at the same time 
 Fixed using the simple 'Save' button would unpause the game while still having the menu overlay opened



That's it — hope you enjoy the updated experience and have a lovely day :3

Oh, and make sure full version of SuchArt is in your wishlist on Steam so you don't miss the release - it's coming soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1293180/SuchArt_Genius_Artist_Simulator/

notes.title: Minor update 1.1.2.2
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Don’t mind the big-ish size of the update, for this is mostly a lie (again! :o) due to updating the game engine.

Yet, here are the changes:

Changes

 Added an autosave option. By default every 30 minutes, customizable in the options
 Spray cans don’t have an infinite amount of paint anymore
 Smoother brushes rotation (especially noticeable for large brushes)
 Some brushes can now do some side movements without rotating (mostly for large brushes)
 Other minor changes


Fixes

 Fixed the painted textures would not be saved for some players having their Shader Model < 5.0
 Fixed some items could prevent the split doors from closing when they shouldn’t actually block them
 Fixed taking a hot spray can in hand would cause the preview of the can (in inventory) not to update properly
 Fixed couldn't bind the inventory slot 10 in the game's settings
 Other minor fixes


Happy trees, clouds, and anything-else-you-may-fancy painting!

notes.title: Update 1.0.9.2 — new tools, fixes and more!
notes.notes:
Hey there,

As you all know, it’s been almost a month since the release of Creative Space. So, do you know what time it is? Right, it’s time for an update! A relatively big one on top of that.

First of all, we’ve unlocked 3 more items from the full game:

- A small painting knife
- Slices of wood (can be decorative or used as a canvas)
- A color-shifter tool

Now you’ve got even more stuff to toy around with and create your dream art, yay! But wait a bit, that’s not it just yet — here a few other changes:

- Players now start the game with a bit of pocket money (100C)
- Money rewards for commissions are slightly increased
- Selling time on the marketplace has been lowered
- Fixed in-game time would go slower if the game had low FPS (which means faster emails answers, deliveries, and marketplace sells for players being below 60FPS)

Okay, now that’s it. Cool, right? Sounds like a perfect occasion to dig into the game again (to try all the new tools and spend your precious pocket money at least). 


Traditionally, here are some amazing paintings made by our amazing players. Not a top 10, but still — let’s enjoy them together!

Take care, see you soon <3

notes.title: Minor update 1.0.8.2
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Here is a small update trying to look like a big one. But the 200Mb are a lie.


 Added 3840x2160 screen resolution
 Minor re-organization of some options screen
 Fixed the FX of the remote controlled car reactors
 Fixed quick-loading would crash if there was no existing save file
 Fixed stamps not showing the right color after loading a saved game
 Adjusted the stamps' painting behaviour (just a tiny bit nicer)
 Some memory optimization (and we have here the culprit of this seemingly somewhat-big update: many assets have been updated to be lighter in memory, among other things)


That's it! Wishing everyone a great day and great painting!

notes.title: Minor update 1.0.6.2
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Here are a few bug fixes and new game options!

Additions and changes

Added an option to limit or remove the slight camera movement happening while painting
Added a FOV slider option
Added an option to invert the mouse left and right clicks actions
Added the 3440x1440 screen resolution
Updated the FPS pointer, now featuring a cute little dot instead of a cross


Bug fixes

Fixed the mop leaving stains on the floor, not fully drying
Fixed a bug which could cause some players to have a broken in-game computer
More consistent paint roller head rotation across different inputs (mouse, controller...)
Fixed one way the player could get stuck under the large canvas lift
Fixed an occlusion issue with the ceiling 


That's it! Let us know on our discord channel if your encounter any bug <3
And happy painting!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here is a small update, covering a range of fixes and minor changes.

Fixes

Fixed hanging an object on a split door could prevent the said door from closing
Fixed the emails' accepting-a-commission button not being interactable anymore after the player was getting told about already having too many ongoing commissions (ie: hard-to-phrase minor bug fix)
Fixed some bits of the delivery room not being paintable
Fixed the music ball's inventory preview not updating properly
Fixed some occlusion issues (ie parts of the studio disappearing if standing in some specific locations)
Reduced spray fumes particles effect from bright sprays, and reduced clipping from the effect
Fixed buckets would sometimes slowly but surely fly away when the game was paused
Fixed drying a wet metallic surface with the hairdryer would make the surface more reflective instead of actually drying it
Fixed fast clicking several times to sell a painting could cause the terminal to bug
Fixed buckets were kindly being delivered full of water
Fixed walking on an area freshly painted and cleaned would still produce paint steps despite having been cleaned
Applying fresh paint on top of dry paint should now mix less than before (this was especially noticeable with painting knife and with brushes low on paint)
More stable buckets (reduced jitter, especially when full of items)


Other changes

Better bobblehead and wooden easel colliders
Better blowtorch smoke effect and surface burning
Changed the rotation icon for the painting knife tool
Added a minimum required distance to be able to spill the content of a bucket (when being in hand)
Added an option to limit the FPS of the game. It seems though to cause some jitter, at least from what I have tested, I am not sure if this will be the case for everyone who tries to use it. So let's say this is still an experimental feature!


That's it! Please reach out (preferably on our discord server) if you experience any bug, and happy painting!
